svg.title: Red eye: red flags decide whether it is vision threatening. Without them it is the lids, a conjunctivitis told apart by its discharge and itch, a subconjunctival hemorrhage or a corneal abrasion; with them it is keratitis, anterior uveitis or acute angle closure glaucoma and needs urgent ophthalmology; each column gives the presentation, the exam finding that decides it and the treatment, with the differential by structure below

svg.text: • lids: blepharitis · stye · chalazion · ectropion · entropion

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • conjunctiva: bacterial, gonococcal, chlamydial, viral, allergic conjunctivitis · subconjunctival hemorrhage

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • cornea: bacterial or herpetic keratitis · abrasion (foreign body) · chemical burn (acid, alkali)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • anterior chamber: anterior uveitis · acute angle closure

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • other: orbital vs preseptal cellulitis · endophthalmitis · blunt trauma (orbital fracture) · penetrating injury · scleritis · herpes zoster ophthalmicus

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • NOT: blepharitis · stye, chalazion · conjunctivitis · dry eye · abrasion · subconjunctival hemorrhage

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • THREATENING: scleritis · corneal ulcer, keratitis · uveitis · acute angle closure · trauma · orbital cellulitis
